answer: Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the falcon queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1831 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the forge. The willow index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 75 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
